summary: A strictly black-and-white, cinema-themed single page for a variable grotesque system (width, weight, italic): pinned looping type videos ('A MOVING STORY', 'dimensional', 'CHANGE', 'MULTISCRIPT') alternate with white chapters of history, owl-carousel detail and stylistic-set slides, a five-width style table and a 1000-glyph grid, ending with a filmed flipbook and a 'Now available on your screen' end card. Most specimens are images or videos rather than live text; the live tester is a hidden full-screen panel opened from the menu.
